CT.rule: Pets are BANNED in all Connecticut STATE PARK campgrounds. Allowed ONLY at four state FOREST campgrounds: American Legion/Hawes (100103), Pachaug Green Falls (100802), Pachaug Mount Misery (100800), Salt Rock (100128).
CT.leash: 7 ft max; no pets in buildings or on rustic cabin sites

MA.rule: Dogs allowed at most DCR campgrounds. Valid rabies vaccination certificate REQUIRED at check-in. Up to 4 pets per site, leashed. Not in cabins/yurts, on the beach, or in buildings.

NY.rule: Most NY State Parks and DEC campgrounds allow up to 2 pets in designated loops. Proof of current rabies vaccination REQUIRED (paper certificate; metal tags not accepted). Leash max 6 ft. No pets on beaches, in picnic areas or buildings. Banned on Lake George Islands sites.

RI.rule: Varies by campground - confirm with the park before booking.

VT.rule: Vermont State Parks allow pets at tent/RV and lean-to sites; proof of current rabies vaccination is required. Pets are NOT allowed in cabins/cottages or on day-use swim beaches. Verified per-site: the booking record reports 'Pets Allowed: Domestic'.

_comment_site_types: Availability counts are misleading unless you filter these out. Verified live on ReserveAmerica: Myles Standish SF showed 12 'open' sites that were all HORSE REQUIRED; Mount Greylock's 8 were all GROUP CAMPING; Rutland SP and Pulaski SP's openings were day-use SHELTERS/PAVILIONS.
_comment_waterfront: true_waterfront = sites where the water is at the edge of the site. near_water = campground on a lake but sites set back. Built from research + site maps; verify before you drive.

lake_campgrounds.name: Tolland State Forest
lake_campgrounds.note: Campground sits on a peninsula into the reservoir; many sites have direct water frontage.

lake_campgrounds.name: DAR State Forest
lake_campgrounds.note: Loop sits above the lake; beach and boat launch, sites are wooded and set back.

lake_campgrounds.name: Nickerson State Park
lake_campgrounds.note: Very clean kettle ponds, Cape Cod. Most sites one row back.

lake_campgrounds.name: Beartown State Forest
lake_campgrounds.note: Only 12 sites, clean pond, quiet.

lake_campgrounds.name: Green Falls Campground (Pachaug SF)
lake_campgrounds.note: The ONLY dog-legal Connecticut public campground on still water. Rustic, very clean spring-fed pond.

lake_campgrounds.name: Lake Waramaug State Park
lake_campgrounds.note: Sites strung along the shoreline - but pets are BANNED (state park).

lake_campgrounds.name: North-South Lake Campground
lake_campgrounds.note: Catskills; the nicest lake water in range, several genuinely lakefront sites.

lake_campgrounds.name: Mongaup Pond
lake_campgrounds.note: Largest pond in the Catskills outside the reservoirs; lakefront sites.

lake_campgrounds.name: Woodford State Park
lake_campgrounds.note: Highest-elevation VT state park (2,400 ft); small clean reservoir, sites ring the water. Closest VT lake option.

lake_campgrounds.name: Lake Shaftsbury State Park
lake_campgrounds.note: Only group lean-to + pavilion bookable online - not a regular campground.

lake_campgrounds.name: Jamaica State Park
lake_campgrounds.note: River, not a lake.

lake_campgrounds.name: Emerald Lake State Park
lake_campgrounds.note: Very clean spring-fed lake in the Taconics; sites are wooded and set back.

lake_campgrounds.name: Bomoseen State Park
lake_campgrounds.note: Largest lake entirely within VT.

lake_campgrounds.name: Half Moon Pond State Park
lake_campgrounds.note: Remote, quiet, many sites right on the pond; several paddle-in.

lake_campgrounds.name: Ricker Pond State Park
lake_campgrounds.note: Groton SF; a row of sites sits directly on the pond.

lake_campgrounds.name: Kettle Pond State Park
lake_campgrounds.note: Remote/walk-in sites on a very clean pond.

lake_campgrounds.name: Green River Reservoir State Park
lake_campgrounds.note: Paddle-in only. Arguably the cleanest, most remote lakefront camping in New England - every site is on the water.

lake_campgrounds.name: Maidstone State Park
lake_campgrounds.note: Exceptionally clear loon lake in the Northeast Kingdom.

lake_campgrounds.name: Lake Carmi State Park
lake_campgrounds.note: NOTE: Lake Carmi has a documented recurring cyanobacteria problem - check before swimming.

lake_campgrounds.name: Burton Island State Park
lake_campgrounds.note: Boat/ferry access only.

_comment_private: Private lakefront campgrounds. These are where the genuinely-on-the-water dog-friendly sites are near New Haven, but their booking engines (Campspot/DataDome, Firefly, RoverPass) block scripted access - call them.

private_lakefront.name: Point Folly Campground (White Memorial)
private_lakefront.note: 47 sites on a peninsula into Connecticut's largest natural lake. Best geographic match to 'right on the water' near New Haven.
private_lakefront.dogs: yes - leashed, rabies proof may be required

water_quality_sources.note: Early September is peak cyanobacteria season in New England. Always check before you swim.

_comment_ny_in_range: NY has ~160 facilities, most 4-6h away (Adirondacks, Thousand Islands, Finger Lakes). The storefront exposes no coordinates, so this curated list bounds the NY scan to Hudson Valley / Taconics / Catskills / Harriman / Long Island.

newbook.name: Odetah Camping Resort
newbook.dogs: tent/RV sites yes; banned in cabins/yurts

campspot_notes.holiday_note: Most CT Campspot parks enforce a 3-night minimum on Labor Day weekend; a 2-night Fri-Sun query returns nothing while Fri-Mon is wide open. Always query both.

phone_only.name: Witch Meadow Lake Family Campground
phone_only.waterfront: true_waterfront (separately priced waterfront class; Labor Day 3-night waterfront rate $415)

phone_only.name: Sylvan Lake Beach Park
phone_only.waterfront: 20 rustic tent sites near the lake

hipcamp_lakefront_leads.name: Quentins Treehouse
hipcamp_lakefront_leads.note: single structure literally on the water; dogs allowed

hipcamp_lakefront_leads.name: North Shore Woods on Beach Pond

_comment_hipcamp: Hipcamp's GraphQL (api.hipcamp.com/graphql, header HIPCAMP-API-KEY from the JS bundle) answers 404 to scripted POSTs even with the key, platform header and www cookies - not solved. The listing page's __NEXT_DATA__ carries the site list but ignores date params.
_comment_vt: Vermont runs the same Aspira/ReserveAmerica storefront on its own domain (vtstateparks-visit.com, contractCode=VT). Waterfront ratings here are from park knowledge, not the booking record - VT's site details do not carry a waterfront flag. Nothing in VT is under ~2.5h from New Haven.

pets_banned_park_ids._note: RI: 'Pets are not permitted at Charlestown Breachway or East Beach Campgrounds, or at any RI state beach.' These sites leave the Pets Allowed field blank rather than 'N', so a blank-means-ok filter lets them through.
